connector.name: Quackr
connector.registryDescription: Virtual phone numbers for SMS verification, OTP receipt, and number management.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.quackr.io over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package quackr-mcp. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace io.quackr, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token in the form 'Bearer <your Quackr API key>', from your profile page at quackr.io

env.name: QUACKR_API_KEY
env.description: Your Quackr API key, from your profile page at quackr.io
